name: diffusers
description_en: 🤗 Diffusers: State-of-the-art diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation in PyTorch.
readme_excerpt: 🤗 Diffusers is the go-to library for state-of-the-art pretrained diffusion models for generating images, audio, and even 3D structures of molecules. Whether you're looking for a simple inference solution or training your own diffusion models, 🤗 Diffusers is a modular toolbox that supports both.
